hooks.name: Bash Serialization Guard
hooks.description: PreToolUse guard on the shell tool that breaks the sleep-polling failure mode: rejects sleep-based waiting and sleep loops, cargo output piped through a filter, a second cargo while one holds the target-dir lock, and a cargo build/test issued with the default 120 s timeout (shorter than this workspace's test run, so the output is lost and the terminal stays busy). Fails open on any internal error; R4 keeps a one-shot marker in $TMPDIR so it can never deadlock if the timeout field is spelled differently by the client. Logic lives in .kiro/hooks/bin/bash-serialization-guard.sh.
